scope.comments: HTML comments masked before reading. No author notes, evidence HTML, prior verdicts or discovery results were read.

method.reading: Every sentence/fragment and paragraph of all 12 episode bodies, all 12 indices and all 43 actual treatment parents was read through its end before this candidate batch. Classifications are human judgments from that reading, not generated negatives for unseen material.
method.rows: Each sentence unit stores exact Unicode character offsets into annotation-masked UTF-8-sig-decoded text (comments become spaces retaining newlines). Dash means all applicable sentence-level named failures tested no. Finding IDs give yes-candidates and failure names once. Paragraph rows independently record all four parent-copying tests: dash means all no; IDs mean candidate yes.
method.sentence_precision: Punctuation-based units can split ellipses/abbreviations or retain fragments; they are reading locators rather than a linguistic parse. Entire blocks were read in context. Headings/navigation/metadata are tagged; only applicable expression questions are asserted for them.
method.parent_precision: Per-paragraph parents list the actual full H2 body passages read. These ranges can be broader than the minimal semantic parent; findings give narrower yes comparisons. This does not claim a fully disambiguated one-to-one paragraph mapping.
method.copy_precision: P findings are initial unresolved candidates, as the contract requires; candidate scope can span several explicitly listed paragraphs.
